description: Player 1's aggro deck for the full seeded game. Twenty cheap-to-cast cards that ask NOTHING at play time beyond the zone a permanent goes into: no card here declares a target, a mode, a direction, an X, an embiggen price or a Tribute (R81), and none of them opens a PendingChoice while it resolves (no Discover, no chained step, no chosen discard). That is what lets the spec drive a whole game through the board with only two pickers ever appearing - the opening mulligan and the zone grid - so a completed game is a statement about the hotseat loop and the replay hash rather than about prompt plumbing. The curve is aggro on purpose (thirteen cards at 1 or 2 mana, nothing above 4) so the hero race ends inside the 30 player-turn cap on most seeds: #11 Tempo Timmy, #32 Prem Panther, #45 Deft Duelist and #56 Jilliax can attack the turn they land (Rush or Charge), #20 Pointmaster and #25 4-mana 7/7 hit hard, #15 Me and Mr Token and #62 Friend of Felinors widen the board for free, and #19 Midrange Menace and #73 Anti-oneshot Armor are the only brakes.
